producer_report.summary:
I added the std-only `athena-testkit` crate. Its `write_executable` writes through an `sh` child (`cat > tmp && chmod 755 tmp && mv tmp final`), so a test process never holds a script open for writing. I moved the helper there from `athena_git::script_writer` and deleted that module. All test sites now use it, including the fake `cargo` in `slot_exec.rs`, and the busy-file retry in `reading.rs` `check_stub` is gone. I did not run the full `cargo test --workspace`; that is left to Athena's checks. Clippy with `-D warnings` is clean, and the targeted test runs listed in `checks_run` pass. The `cargo test -p xtask --test policy` run is included.

Two new integration tests in the crate back this up. `no_in_process_exec_writes` scans test code for `set_executable(`, `set_permissions(`, `from_mode(`, `.set_mode(`, `.mode(<arg>)` and a `chmod` child, and fails on any. It has planted-violation tests for each. `stand_in_stress` printed `helper variant: 0 ETXTBSY in 800 cycles` and `in-process variant: 21 ETXTBSY in 800 cycles`. The in-process count depends on timing, so it is printed and not asserted.

The scan exempts three files, each with a reason: the scan file itself, the stress file (whose in-process variant writes the bad way on purpose), and `crates/athena-cli/src/slot_exec.rs`. That last one is out of scope per the brief, and its unit-test helper also writes non-executable modes. A guard test fails if an exemption goes stale.

I also added D160 to `docs/decisions.md` and a D08→D160 `[[link]]` to `docs/decision-links.toml`. The `shard-timings.txt` lines, the `athena-testkit` architecture row, the `Cargo.toml`/`Cargo.lock` changes and the CHANGELOG Fixed entry are in too. No production hunk changed: the only non-test edit is the removed `pub mod script_writer;` line.

The `athena-agent` dev-dependency on `athena-git` is replaced by `athena-testkit`, because the one use in that crate was the helper.

checks_run.note: lib 2, scan 10, stress 2 all pass; helper variant 0 ETXTBSY in 800 cycles; in-process variant 21 ETXTBSY in 800 cycles
applied formatting; the check form was not run separately

criteria_check.criterion: crates/athena-testkit/Cargo.toml exists as a std-only dev-dependency crate with a workspace [lints] table, and is a workspace member in Cargo.toml. CHANGELOG.md names the root cause: executable stand-ins written in-process with no single helper and no mechanical enumeration of write sites. It also names the fix at the origin: athena_testkit::write_executable, which writes via an sh child (cat > tmp && chmod 755 tmp && mv tmp final).
criteria_check.evidence: Created crates/athena-testkit/Cargo.toml (empty [dependencies], tempfile dev-dep only, [lints] workspace = true); added to Cargo.toml members and workspace.dependencies; the CHANGELOG Unreleased Fixed entry names the root cause and the sh-child fix with the exact command.

criteria_check.criterion: Grep of test code (xtask/src/main.rs, crates/athena-cli/tests/*.rs, crates/athena-agent/src/claude.rs, crates/athena-core/src/{checks,reading}.rs, crates/athena-git/src/snapshot.rs tests) finds no in-process executable write. The xtask gitleaks fake and crates/athena-cli/tests/slot_exec.rs use the helper, and crates/athena-git/src/script_writer.rs is deleted with no remaining references.
criteria_check.evidence: Grep for script_writer in *.rs finds nothing after the conversion; script_writer.rs removed and its pub mod dropped; slot_exec.rs and both xtask fakes call athena_testkit::write_executable; the scan test no_in_process_exec_writes passes over the tree.

criteria_check.criterion: Run `cargo test -p athena-testkit`. The scan test no_in_process_exec_writes passes on the tree. Its planted-violation unit tests show it fails on set_executable(&fake) wrappers, set_permissions with 0o755, from_mode and Command::new("chmod") in test code. These tests would fail without the detection logic.
criteria_check.evidence: Ran cargo test -p athena-testkit: 10 scan tests pass, including planted set_executable, set_permissions 0o755, from_mode, set_mode/.mode(arg), chmod child, cfg(test) region, and negative cases; each asserts exact hits from the shared violations function. The exempt-list guard test also passes.

criteria_check.criterion: Run `cargo test -p athena-testkit --test stand_in_stress`. The helper variant records 0 ETXTBSY over many write-then-exec cycles with concurrent forking threads. The in-process variant's hit count appears in the recorded test output.
criteria_check.evidence: Ran with --nocapture: 'helper variant: 0 ETXTBSY in 800 cycles' and 'in-process variant: 21 ETXTBSY in 800 cycles'; both tests pass. The count is printed with eprintln!, so a run without --nocapture shows it only on failure.

criteria_check.criterion: git diff shows no non-test production change. The busy-file retry in reading.rs check_stub is removed, and production retry_busy in claude.rs is untouched.
criteria_check.evidence: Edits to .rs files are in test regions (claude.rs stand_in_tests, checks.rs/reading.rs/snapshot.rs/xtask main.rs tests), the new crate, and the removed pub mod line in athena-git lib.rs. check_stub is now a one-line BinaryChecker call; retry_busy was not edited.

criteria_check.criterion: docs/decisions.md and docs/decision-links.toml have an appended entry saying the decision covering crates/athena-git/src/snapshot.rs was checked and stands. xtask/shard-timings.txt lists the new test files. docs/architecture.md's crate table lists athena-testkit.
criteria_check.evidence: Appended D160 (Decision line 4443 starts 'Amends D08 in prose only') and a [[link]] D08->D160 at line 4443; four athena-testkit lines added to shard-timings.txt; architecture row added. cargo test -p athena-cli --lib decisions, backtest, mirrors, and xtask policy and ci_shards all pass.

criteria_check.criterion: Run `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets` and `cargo test --workspace`. All pass.
criteria_check.evidence: left to Athena's checks. I ran cargo fmt --all and cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings (clean), plus the targeted tests above; I did not run the full workspace test suite.

open_issues: crates/athena-cli/src/slot_exec.rs keeps its unit-test helper that calls set_permissions (out of scope per the brief, and it also writes non-executable modes). It is listed in the scan's exempt list with the reason, and a guard test fails if the entry goes stale.
The CHANGELOG history entry for D157 still mentions athena_git::script_writer. I left it as history; the new entry says the module moved and was deleted.
Cargo.lock appears in the file list because cargo wrote it; I did not edit it by hand.
I did not run the full cargo test --workspace (left to Athena's checks).
mistakes: The first CHANGELOG edit failed because '### Fixed' occurs many times; I redid it with more context. No effect on the result.
learnings: The decisions tests live in the athena-cli lib (cargo test -p athena-cli --lib decisions), not in a separate test target.
The Cargo.lock entries were written by the first non-locked cargo build; later --locked runs pass.
A should_panic test for a missing directory cannot match on the panic message: the failure surfaces either as the write error or as the exit-status assert, depending on timing.
desires: A way to read oversized tool-result files that sit outside the working directory.
